parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle to adjust the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to open or close the water flow and mix hot and cold water.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel to provide structural support and house the internal water channels.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the spout and switch, channels water from the inlet pipes to the spout, and supports the faucet assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base for the faucet components.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water exits the fixture.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet body to the sink, often designed with an aerator to control flow and reduce splashing.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water to different areas of the sink.
